title: foghorn voice
description: The voice of a set of release notes. foghorn reads it in the draft skill and the checker.

person.description: first: the maintainer says I and we where the source does. third: the project is the subject.

creditStyle.description: esbuild: both 'Thanks to @x for reporting' and 'This fix was contributed by @x'. thanks: only the thanks sentence. by-line: 'Reported by @x. Fixed by @y.'

text.description: The bold line that opens a breaking release.

pinning.description: The pinning advice. {package} and {previous} are placeholders.

affectsLine.description: Add an optional Affects: line (and a To check: line) when a change can break someone.

maxEntryChars.description: The checker warns when the prose and the code blocks of an entry together are longer.

creditOwner.description: Credit the owner of the repository as well. Off by default: a maintainer who ships alone credits only outside contributors and reporters.

severity.description: Map a check id to 'hard' or 'warn' for this voice. The esbuild preset softens entry-no-link-or-credit, because esbuild's own notes break it.
